content: Happened to come actress this App while looking for a widget that would give me the hours remaining for alarm time. This does that and a whole lot more. A really great visualization of calendar reminders with a quick view of how long to the next event. It took awhile to configure to my liking but now working great. I'm not sure how to save the widget confirguarsion beyond the current saved version but maybe I'm missing that. . App seems very stable and highly functional. Very impressed.

I hope dev keeps going with it. This is the most original and useful productivity app out there. Time is cyclical, sunrise then sunset ad. Infinitum. Never made sense to me to think about time during the day as a chronological line moving downward, like on a traditional planner. Sectograph only gets better the more you use it. It's really special. Install and play around. The initial learning curve is how you know it's so good, you'll see.

This is one of those potential game-changer apps; thoughtfully designed, programmed well, and dare I say revolutionary. I found myself ignoring the normal calendar "Schedule" widget for lack of accessibility. The presentation of the Sectograph app and widget are both intuitive and attractive. It's a sure sign that a product is good when you start to rethink planning and scheduling from the ground up. I also applaud the developer for taking a more nuanced approach by offering a robust and functional app (without tacky ads) with optional and significant add-on purchases. After using it for a week I'm ready to fully support the creators with a purchase--probably the highly customizable pallete chooser but I'm also curious about the 24 hour display function. This is development done right. This is one of those apps that is so good you want to see what else has been made by the same people. Cheers.

Love this app! I always want to visualize my schedule, but seeing everything in list or crammed schedule somehow stress me out a lot. But seems like this clock-like visualization works well for me! I use todoist and google calendar to sync up with this, and add some emoji to the event title, make the viz even more clear! Also, the update is one-time payment, which is amazing, also I don't even feel limited in free mode. Hurray to the dev!

Fantastic time interface. I have ADHD, and being able to remedy time blindness with clear information about how much time there is between events and when I need to be ready for things is just perfect. No idea how good the event creation interface is, I've just tied it to my personal and work calendar apps and left it at that. One request, I'd love to be able to further customize the interior of the center ring, I don't like the preset options and would like to just enter a date format string.

I have ADHD and medication can only do so much; planning and organizing are on me to improve. I've tried a variety of apps. The best part for me is that it visually changes throughout the day with upcoming plans, and with plenty of time in advance to still feel in control. All other apps I've used are repetitive, or I don't open them and forget, the same buzz/tone for reminders gets ignored after a few weeks, this one gently reminds right on my home screen and stays visually interesting Perfect
replyContent:
Thanks for the great review! We are very glad that the application really helps you!  
Success in planning! 😊👍

content: It is a lovely interface for your calendar. I think it would be fantastic with a smart watch. I use it as a widget on my phone, and I like the way it maps out my day. I wish I could code the color of the events to specific calendars to reflect how my google calendars are set up, and I would love if it worked with other calendar apps or todo list apps, since google 'reminders' aren't compatible with anything - not even with other google apps.

Out of box, I really am liking it! Usually I don't review things, but it's pretty awesome. Definitely interested to see if it has integrations. Time boxing built in - easier day view migration of tasks that sync to google calendar. I think it would be awesome to create a time box for list of similar grouped tasks that's communicated to google calendar, able to move them to and from groups. Overall, the app has a lot of customizations. It feels more like a Tasker or Nova for your to-do list.

I really like this app and it is definitely a very nice visual way to keep track of time. The one MAJOR issue I keep encountering though is that it does not seem to easily sync with my Google calendar, which is where I have all my daily tasks stored. Edit: after trying a few troubleshooting options (including the FAQ suggestions), I was finally able to get Sectograph to begin syncing again by uninstalling and reinstalling Google calendar. It seems like it was a one-time glitch. Love this app!

I first found Sectograph shortly after becoming an Android user for the first time and loved it! Then I started getting into theming, especially very minimalistic theming, and the widget didn't fit well on many of my home screen layouts (my preference, not any issue with the app). But now with the notification bar option, it's back in regular use!! I'm entertaining the idea of getting a smart watch, so it's exciting to see that would be an option as well! Thanks for an awesome app!
replyContent:
Thank you for sharing your story and opinion on the latest update. This is important for us!  
Good luck with your planning and take care of yourself!  🙂🙏

content: It looks very slick, and is, so far, my favorite watch face. It really does help me visualize time until my next meeting and how much time I'm able to work outside of meetings. One possible improvement would be the ability to color all of the events coming from a certain calendar together in addition to being able to color them individually. Edit to add: there is already an option for this... awesome! So...maybe the ability to add some tap-able areas on the watch face?

This is one of my favorite apps. With so many thoughtful features, there's a bit of a learning curve so it's important to experiment. Def. capable of replacing your calendar but its true value is the home screen widget. It offers a pro version, which is well worth it, but the free version is every bit of 5 stars itself. One request. can you add a sunrise/sunset event based on location? This feature would integrate perfectly. While you're at it, let's see the moon's phases too!! 🙏🏻🌞🌖🌙🌝👏

This app is awesome, I love the wear os compatibility. I have a couple feature requests. It would be great if you could filter which calendars you can see on the greyscale mode. Also it would be nice to have an option in the settings for making the watch 24 hours always, currently if I restart my watch it switches back to 12 hours, so I have to turn on the tap to toggle feature, tap my watch, then turn off the tap to toggle feature since I don't want to accidentally switch it back.

I don't have an intuitive sense of time due to my ADD. Because of this, I always wear an analog wrist watch which provides a visual sense of time that can't be accomplished with digital watches. This app manages to do much the same thing in how it displays today's events. The free version is good, but the paid version is well worth the extra cost. Creating separate widgets for work and family makes it much easier to not forget my commitments. Sectograph has become the app I check most often.

This is the literal best app I have ever used in my entire life. Awesome features: -Syncs with Smartwatch seamlessly -Syncs with Google Calendar -Look amazing, makes sense. -Has widget option for homescreen Needs Work: -Changing clock appearance is a little clunky. User Interface could be improved. -Changing clock appearance doesn't look ver aesthetic, but it is operational. -App has a little bit of a learning curve to it, but once you learn, it's not difficult and looks amazing.

Totally useful and amazing!! Has definitely helped me with time management and stay on everything. I do wish that it would include my alarms, instead of just my calendar, but I make do and it still works out. I have recommended to many people and they've all gotten it too, they're very grateful. 9.75/10 recommend to all, especially students!

Ok, I definitely need to edit my previous review. This is EXACTLY what I've been looking for in a watchface. Able to integrate my work and personal calendars into a fantastic integration of your watch and agenda. Easy to read, customizable, and honestly just perfect for those on a schedule. Can't believe i couldn't get the app to work on my watch when i first purchased the Pro version. Thanks for the quick response to my earlier review! Top notch developer!
replyContent:
There are a couple of steps you need to take:
Make sure that Bluetooth is active on your smartphone and smart watch.
Go to the Play Market, find the Sectograph (in the "Applications on your smartphone" section) and install it.
After that, you can select a new watch face in your smart watch.

content: This app is the perfect command central. I was just looking for a visual clock, but this is so much more! It is so nice to have an app that automatically syncs with my calendar so I don't have to manually put things in. The interface is super user friendly and the widget is incredibly customizable. I love how clean it looks and how I can customize the buttons to include all my productivity apps in one place.

This really is pretty handy. It does a good job of visually showing what is happening on a specific day. I tried it a couple of years ago and decided not to use it. I gave it another try and I do like it. Although I probably didn't need it, I purchased the Pro version, because I like the idea that the app is not subscription based (I refuse to fall for recurring payments). Very handy and it works seamlessly with Business Calendar 2 Planner.

Cool graphics and easy to use. It pulls directly from the calendar you link it to so you only have to input events once. I'm using Google calendar so the calendar displays everyone I've linked with; great way to keep the family in sync. I'd love to have a To Do list added to the functionality especially one that supports the "bucket" concept so effect for people with ADHD. I am going to purchase the full app.

As someone with ADHD the concept of time is even more abstract and subjective in my head, so I really helps me to be on time when I have a visual representation of time passing and events looming. It's easy to use and understand. Great app! The only thing that would make it better is to make it a watchface I can put on my Samsung watch. I would die a happy human.

Wow this is super helpful. I hope I stick with it. The addition of in app tasks would be nice and if it could pull your alarms from Samsung clock app. I could be wrong, but it doesn't seem to show when my alarms will go off on Samsung clock, just the calendar I'm guessing. More watch face customizations would be nice as well. Like to click to expand an event. This may be included in the paid version, I'm not sure yet, but I will be purchasing the pro version in the near future

Although there are some features that I wish were easier to use, I think this app is very helpful. If it was possible to add a way to easily reorganize the order of events I would enjoy this app even more. Maybe being able to drag the order of events down at the bottom to change the order on the wheel? For now if I need to make a change to my schedule I have to make individual changes to the times of events. Overall a great application.

As someone with time blindness from ADHD, this app is incredibly helpful. The visual map of how far away events are really helps. I love that it syncs up to my Google calendar, so setup was fast. I love how large I can scale the widget up. I immediately payed for the premium version so I could access the 24hr clock face & have no regrets. (Esp when most planner apps are now subscription, a $4, 1-time charge is more than reasonable.) Would be nice to have more visual customization options.

This widget app is so cool. It links right to my Google calendar and shows me in a clock format what my next events are. It's much easier to figure it out in my mind when I see it like this. Rather than go to my calendar and scroll up and down its just a widget on my main screen that shows me details like how many hours til my next event. That's super cool. I think it's a real game changer in daily time keeping.

I have ADHD. Time management and planning are my worst nightmares. This app makes it so easy to SEE my schedule. The visual representation of the wheel makes it easier to make sense of how much time I have. It's also SO helpful to see how far I am into my day... I could go on. It's a great app and worth the premium price, but the free version is also fantastic.

Amazing app that makes keeping track of your calendar easier than ever Edit: after using this app for about 2 months, I find myself more inclined to add things to my calendar so they will show up on my widget. It has vastly helped me keep better track of my time throughout the day. I would highly recommend this to anyone that is looking for an easy [and visually appealing] way to add a little more structure to their day.

Title: An Exceptional Calendar App: The Perfect Tool to Organize Your Days! Rating: ★★★★★ As someone with a busy lifestyle, I have always struggled to effectively plan my days and keep track of my schedule. However, my life has taken a significant turn for the better since I discovered an outstanding calendar app that not only helps me stay organized but also offers a visually stunning and intuitive user experience.

I frickng love this app. Good visual for me who is bad at time management. I prefer to see my schedule in the form of a clock. Google calendar schedule view just doesn't do it for me. Am convinced that those that struggle with using this app are the same people who struggle with adding a contact to their phonebook🙄. It's straightforward and customizable.

So far this app has been really helpful to me. It is a very intuitive way to view time. It helps me realize how much time I *actually* have in my day (which is less than I usually think). It's convenient to have repeating events in it as well. The widget is probably the best part. I get to see my whole day as a nice snapshot and I can always reference what I'm supposed to be doing when. So far, excellent app.

If you use Google calendar and like circular visualizations of your schedule, this is a must have. I paid the premium charge for the full set of features so I can see a 24 hour calendar view, and I'm going to buy and "Wear OS" smartwatch to use this app's smartwatch sync feature to see my widget on both my watch and home screen. Perfect!

This app has a small learning curve but wow is the functionality spot on. Absolutely great for visually representing a schedule. I instantly purchased Pro features for the 24-hour widget and utilize it every minute of the day. What compelled me to write this review was the customization options: this app is compatible with any setup. Thanks for helping me keep track of my time from someone who really needs the help.

Glad I stumbled across this app. I don't change my home screen often (maybe once a year), but this one app convinced me to rearrange the whole screen to accommodate its widget, and I'm glad I did! The way the scheduling interfaces with the clock in the widget is something that should have been thought of a long time ago. Edit: I forgot to mention the watch face and app. I have used the same watch face now for 2 years. This app replaced my Pear watch face and I haven't looked back!

It does a pretty good job. I love the widget, and I love being able to look ahead/behind in time. The worst thing about it is the controls. It was pretty tricky to get a hang of, even after playing with the demo version. You kind of have to teach yourself how everything works before you really get anything out of it, but after you do it is worth it. And I'm not saying it's hard to learn! You just have to invest some time. The best thing is that it SO EASILY adds events from your Google calendar.

This is a unique & creative way to view & follow the agenda of the upcoming day(s) in a concise manner. If necessary, corrections can be incorpordted without involving a chaotic process. Obviously, a team of talented professionals have been able to incorporate their various specialiities so the spectrograph can be easily adjusted. Ràrely, have I posted a review concerning any app. However. the stellar nature of this excellent work product is well deserving of a comment. Thank you.

This apps is amazing at giving you all the information you want in a very clean and simple way. And includes all your time managements needs, analog, digital clock, day of the week and a calander that all functions smoothly and with easy, and works well with other apps. Also works great on a smart watch, littery sold me on getting one, never could find a watch I really liked before this.

This app has been immensely helpful in keeping me organized. I prefer to create events in here as I can't set the duration of an event and that is sometimes more intuitive for me. One thing I would love is having events that happen concurrently stack, instead of laying over each other. I like to schedule small tasks during events where I'm expecting to have free time. I would also love to be able to duplicate events and change the calendar an event was assigned to.

Very unique, customizable and cool way to keep on track with your daily schedule and access your calender. If one has rated this app low do to user difficulty try to use the resources available. The customization is awesome and one of its strong points! Take a little time to learn, you'll realize it's not so tough. A user mentioned having a syncing issue, prob not the app as it seems to be isolated. Also, a user that complained about battery consumption since edited the review + rated 5 stars.

Outstanding, the stock connectivity with various time based applications is perfect and the 5 button layout on the widget is customizable and should be called the 9 button layout! This feature alone is worth the price of admission! Granular controls allow for rich and diverse personalization. My only issue is the app came out in 2013 and I was not on it earlier!!

A must have for me due to watch integration! I'm using a galaxy watch and with that the app puts the schedule right on to the watch face. Makes it incredibly useful to see my schedule at a glance and get reminders. In general the app is great too. I like the visualization concept and the integration with so many calendar apps. Try it out!

Love it! So helpful for my neurodiverget brain. I love the watchface and widget and extensive customization options. I'd like to have the watchface be able to open my calendar when pressed. Thanks for making the free version for all to be able to use! I didnt even need to buy the upgrade but did anyway just to say thanks for developing such an amazingly helpful app!

Firstly, I have to say that this app is one of the most brilliant apps I've ever seen. I love it, I've used it for ages, and it improves my life in a huge way to be able to see my calendar events on a clock. Five stars. Secondly, I'd like to add that if you could make this work with Proton Calandar, it'd help me have less Google. in my life. I could finally migrate, and that would make me thrilled all over again.

Sectograph provides something immensely valuable: a watch face that makes life with ADHD slightly less harrowing. Oddly enough, it was exactly what I was looking for in practically every respect. Not just a good enough fit; it's like someone read my mind. And if you don't need the paid features, it doesn't bombard you with ads as punishment. It doesn't even crash or bog your device down with unnecessary processing. I literally cannot find any flaws with it.

This app helps me keep track of my life. I am able to display all meetings from work and my other calendars and they're color codes so I know what type of appointment it is. Using the widget and watch app together has made my day so much easier to manage and I haven't missed a meeting since I started using it. Slight learning curve with all the settings but well worth it.

I love this app, great way to view my agenda for today, pro version really worth it. The option to get both from google cal and outlook is awesome as well. And the support of wear os is a blessing. I recommend this app ro anyone who asks. One feature request for the wearOS: would be awesome to be able to include some indicators, like steps or something (the ring for battery is perfect). But even without that feature, this is my fav watch face

This is my favorite app. For me, having a visual representation of my daily schedule prevents me from missing important things. I have ADD and haven't had success with a regular calendar, but with the sectograph widget on my phone, I can see my schedule superimposed on a clock face every time I check my phone. This helps me a lot. There is a little bit of a learning curve to understand just what you are looking at, but the tutorial is good and once you understand it is very intuitive.
replyContent: Thank you for your warm and detailed review 😊🙏

content: I really like this app. It helps me visually see how much time I have scheduled for each event. I have it synced with my Google calendar. One recommendation I would make is having different themes for how the widget looks. With my background image, the widget can sometimes be a little difficult to read. But other than that, I would recommend it.
replyContent: Thank you very much for your feedback and recommendation! 😊👍

content: I love the ability to visualize my day ahead with the home screen widget. I just made the transition toward keeping a rigorous, whole-life schedule using Google Calendar, and this app seamlessly integrates with my existing calendar without any effort on my part. Highly recommended for those undertaking the necessary task of organizing their lives.

This app finally did what I have wanted. Made a visually appealing way to portray my calendar that is also WearOS compatible. What really helps the visual appeal is the complete control over customization the user is given. Keep up the great work! I would love if clicking the event on the WearOS watch face showed the full event details like the Phone widget does. But perhaps that's not possible with a watch face.

This application should be considered by all who have a vision and a dream to succeed. Those who fail to plan, plan to fail. Sectograph allows you to elaborately plan and prioritize effectively. I absolutely recommend this to all busy professionals who still are positively moved by their achievements. However, i don't think this is for the nonambitious type who are already satisfied completely with where they stand in life. This app can boost your productivity, in a life changing way. Try it!

It's by far the best time tracking app for me, helped me a lot with keeping track of my schedules and getting works done by the time, the only thing I can suggest is showing up the widget when the screen is locked so the user doesn't have to unlock the screen to take a glance at what's the next to-do in his/her daily schedule You've done a great job, thanks for this amazing app, keep it this way, neat and functional, ads will destroy the app, don't resort to the ads

1st: Great concept. Except for the fact that nothing is showing up. It's just a blank clock no matter how much forward I skip. No matter how many times I close the app in hopes of refreshing. None of my events even show up on the widget. Deleting. 2nd: Deleted and redownloaded. It works now.
replyContent: Check that you have events for the next 12 hours and the desired calendar is selected in the "My calendars" menu.  If you use the Google Calendar app to edit events, see the “Slow Sync with Google Calendar App” section in the FAQ in the app.  If nothing helps, write to me at 27applab@gmail.com

content: A brilliant idea, an entirely new way to look at the passage of time that strikes me as having advantages to this square-calendar-concept that is the default. I will admit I have used it in a while, but whenever I do I really enjoy this new way of seeing the time available to me and how it is filled. It gives a clearer perspective about how soon things are. If I had a smart watch and this was a function, I might just look at it all the time.

Life-changing, if you use the app right it can very much help you like no other app I've found so far! I have to say a big thank you to the developers, you have no idea how much you've helped me and my family in a time of crisis by just something as simple as this although I do wish there was an option in the app so that the notifications worked like alarms because I have to use a separate app to do that because notifications are so timid. Actually truly life-changing thank you

I got this app in hopes it would be more task/time management oriented. I wanted an app that helped me divide up and plan to do assignments and tasks by completion time. While this app is not what I was looking for, it's certainly very useful. I love being able to combine all of my calendars in one app that displays my calendar events in a neat, organized graphic

I struggle very badly with time management due to ADHD. I absolutely love this app and the way you can put a wiget on your screen. I'd say I'm still struggling but I've only had the app one week & I see improvement in my day planning. Syncs with google calander. I wish I had this app as a stationary screen or watch. Really helps you plan out your day and get an idea of how much time is left & passing. Takes a day or so to get use to it though. Just wish 'reminders' were able to show

Great idea. A clock dial is certainly how I like to visualize the day. But... the widget's "Visualization of old events" should have an "All" setting; I use the calendar to record what I have done, so I like to look backwards. 3 hours back is insufficient.

Such a great app! I have some requests! On the WearOS watch: 1) Have titles to scroll in place so we can read the whole event title 2) Have all day events take up a larger fraction of the watch perimeter, preferably as much as possible, shrinking to fit the available space if more than one all-day event is present 3) Make the start time and event length optional elements on the watch face so we can fit in more title space 4) change the sectors in ambient mode so the text is white with a thin opaque black shadow and the sector itself is the same grey, but uses a diagonal stripe pattern so the total OLED power consumption is substantially lower.

This is a great app, and it's helped me stay organized in just these last few days. I'm currently working around Google's Reminder issue (it's not accessible per Google's restrictions) by adding a subset to my calendar and setting Events there as reminders. I'd really love for touchable zones on the watch to open applicable apps. And those outer rings could be linked to step goals or other targets!

This app is great for what it's for. I can easily manage my Google Calendar in an intuitive way. When I've tried to enter my daily routine using only my calendar, the amount of information was overwhelming. With Sectograph there's a natural flow to how I see the events of the day unfolding.

Love the widget, took a minute to figure out all the buttons to sync the watch. Very customizable, which is great! It was my mistake. This is great for my ADD. It allows me to time block so I can get a little distracted and still be on task. So worth the money.

I quite enjoy playing with this sectograph. It's easy to set up with as many of you (google) calendars as you want.Once you've familiarize yourself with the settings, it's a quick visual reminder of all your tasks for the day. The adjustable widget size means i can have a giant, readable version on my home screen.

content: 100% of my day is based on my agenda. Each calendar event is right on my Samsung Galaxy Watch4. Sectorgraph makes my Wear OS device worth so much more, meaning I would buy my watch just for this watch face. I love how my personal and work calendars with colors both are synced and how the past events up to 3 hours are visible. Plus Holidays, birthdays, anniversaries and all day events are also visible on the outer border of my watch face. Note: There are no third party ads in the free version.

I originally doubted how this would help me. But decided to try it & see exactly it was meant to do For me, he most useful thing is it fits my daily schedule into a 4×4 size widget. Using a small % of my screen. + the way it's organized, just a quick glance & I see what's happening for the whole day. Way more efficient than digging thru my calendar app. I use a month calendar widget, but don't want to make a 2nd large agenda widget. This solved the problem perfectly!

*Note to Samsung users: the app wouldn't update to my google calendar until I selected to "always use" google calendar on the pop up window asking what app to use.*👍 I have really struggled following the schedules I create and something about this visual and seeing how much time I have left to complete something or until the next scheduled item has already been beneficial! I put the widget on my home screen to try to help me not get screen-time distracted as well. Thank you developers!!!!!❤

This app is fantastic! I work from home anyway, and with the disruption due to the Coronavirus, it was difficult to maintain my usual schedule. By the end of the day, I hadn't accomplished much and really didn't know where the time had gone. I downloaded Sectograph and it has made all the difference. I am getting my work done and even have free time to enjoy. I even recommended it on Twitter yesterday.

Sectograph is so helpful for me to visualize my day and how I'm going to spend my time. It's almost like a pie chart of my time, perfect for this visual learner. What I would love is a companion app (watch face or widget) on Samsung Galaxy watches so I can see it on my wrist, too. I use the the widget on my phone's home screen all the time. I love it!

Sectograph is probably my favorite phone app. I have a hard time with time management and the way that sectograph displays the time and all the ways I can customize it makes it fantastic. It always works, I never have any issues with it and the developer is very quick to help if needed. Highly recommend!

I do like this app. I honestly have not fully used it to it's full potential yet but that's mainly because I have a very settled down, low key, schedule these days, but when I do have an event I can view it on my home screen which I love. I love the organization of my events and it does go great with Google calendar.

Very clever app. It's clear a lot of thought went into this. Quite customizable and you can still have all the button actions go to your existing calendar app. Bought Pro the same day I downloaded the app... It would be so nice to be able to change the color scheme on the notification widget.

This is exactly what I need to get work organized! I'm a freelancer who has a complicated calendar which I really just need to visualize! The only thing I wish is that I could make it bigger. It's the center of my page now, but it would be great to have it take up all the space. Also weather in the center would be cool (since it replaced my clock/weather widget) thanks folks!

Literally the best scheduling format for me. It just makes so much more sense than anything else. I am surprised this format isn't more widely used. You guys have a gold idea in your hands. The design is very aesthetically pleasing, and the level of customizability is something that all other developers should follow. Also the fact that it has a watch face is the cherry on top. As a software engineer, I say very well done.

Thank you so much for adding the ability to tap an event sector on my watch and see the event details. I noticed that I can not turn off the numbers on the face of the watch now. I see the setting on the app, but nothing happens on my watch when I change the setting. The numbers are always there.
replyContent: Hi, At the moment, clicks on sectors for smart watches are not supported.  We will add this feature.  Recurring events should be displayed.

content: I've been wanting a visual calendar like this for some time, to the point that I considered making my own after I wrap up my current software project. However, this app has all the functionality you could ever want, and I'm absolutely delighted with it. I paid for the upgrade to pro so that I could customize the colors and it was 100% worth the $8. I'm so glad this exists, and I have no desire to make my own when this does everything I need. I can't recommend this product highly enough!

Love this app, gives a great overview of my day and looks great on my watch too! Great motivator for creating routines too by mapping them out on a calendar! I do have some wishes for the app to add in the future. One features is to have the ability to hide event series and not just individual events as work calendars are not very customizable. Another one is for wearos to replace the battery indicator in the middle with a complication. But those are just extras.

Exactly like I imagined an app like this should be. The visualization of my day is more intuitive than it looks like at first, it inspires me to follow a structured routine and it has helped reduce my anxiety greatly, since now my day is all planned, easy to follow, and any gaps in my days are easy to know how much time exactly I'll have, which makes it easier for me to plan. I highly recommend this app if u want a routine but can never follow it

I have been using this for a few years now without ever running into an issue. It's a great widget to have on my home screen to show upcoming work meetings and personal events. content: This app has a lot going for it: intuitive, customizable, with some well-designed features (e.g. sub-lists). Unfortunately, after buying a year's subscription, I found it largely unusable. Not in this app. Here the task just disappears for today, basically setting you up to miss it again. It will only reappear the following day. So if you've missed a task, you'd better tick it off on the same day. Bizarre. Anyway, I'm switching to another app, which seems to be fully developed and so far behaves normally (though it might miss some of the cool features of this one). Either it's too manual, making the todo app more of an interruption, or the sorting doesn't predict my priorities well. The simplest solution would be to combine basic sorting (priority, due date, category, etc) with manual sorting somehow. One way would be to have items initially sorted by your selected method. Then allow the user to manually sort any item. When a new item is placed in a list  the new item would be placed in order according to the those items that have not been manually sorted. If all items in the list have already been manually sorted then there are two approaches I can think of. Either have new items automatically be placed at the top or bottom in those cases, or even better the app could have hidden values for this. e.g. an item due 2/16 that's manually moved ahead of an item due 2/12 would be considered having a "due date" of 2/11 for sorting.

content: I have tried so many task tracking apps because all of them seem to be missing some critical feature, and this one is about as perfect as it gets! The only problem I have with it is the kind of odd way that it handles completing repeating tasks, and I'm hoping this is something that can be slightly altered to make this app perfect! There's two main problems: 1 - When you mark the task as complete, it stays marked as complete until the next time it goes off. You can "un-complete" it and it will appear as a pending task with the next time that it will go off, but this tends to have weird results sometimes. There is an option to "track history of repeating tasks," which duplicates the task when it's marked completed so there's a copy that will repeat and a copy that will go into the task history, but the duplicated task is also marked complete--leading to the same problem as mentioned above. 2 - You can tell the app to either set a completed task to repeat the specified amount of time from when it was completed (option A), or from when it went off (option B). (e.g., if my task that repeats once a week was due at 12pm Friday, but I don't mark it complete until 11am Saturday, Option A will have it repeat the next Saturday, and Option B will have it repeat the next Friday.) It's nice to have this option, but it would be way better if we could set it on a task-by-task basis. For me personally, I have a medication I take every two weeks; sometimes I take it late, and ideally, I should take it again exactly two weeks from then, so I would prefer option A for this one. However, I also have a reminder to back up my PC every Sunday; if I complete this late, I would still prefer option B and be reminded on Sunday every time, because that's when I generally have time to do it. I can only pick one style or the other, so I have it set to option B and just manually alter the ones that need it. It works, but it would be nice to have the option to automate it! Thanks for a great app and sorry for the super long explanation!

I've been really happy with this calendar app. The ability to group calendars and turn the groups off and on is super useful to me. content: I haved used this Calender for my business for over 10 years. It has been a very important part of running my business. The customer service has been very attentive in the past. Although I only reached out to them once about 6 years ago. They immediately reached back out to me to solve my issue. Which I appreciated since I ran my business off of this app. I have it installed in all my work vans. Any job added or edited in the office show up immediately for my techs in the field.

I use this planner as a replacement for a standard Google calendar. I like it so far; it works just fine and I find interface is slightly better than at original app. Icon is cute but sometimes looks like number "30" not letters "BC" but this is my personal issue. No glitches and noticeable bugs so I gave it 5 stars.

Love this calander, ADD/ADHD persons best friend. Got it specifically for the drag/drop and drag/copy options. It also has great template and color coding functions which make it super easy for st a glance scheduling. I still make hand written lists but it also has list and task functions as well if you're a list person.

I have been using this app since I started my small business last fall. This has turned out to be an essential asset to managing my jobs. Its simple, self explanatory. I had know idea it would become my right arm. The more I've used it, the more I've discovered. Most of all. Its free. I haven't noticed any ads. I highly recommend this app for the small business person, who might not now their way around more sophisticated apps. 1 YR LATER Im still using this and have no complaints

Our goto calendar app. Highly configurable app that allows us to get the appearance, font sizes, etc exactly as we like it. Subtle things like the ability to give entries slightly rounded corners makes it easier to see back to back items. Full functionality in all the different areas. The only thing it can't do is to be able to create a Google Meet video call at the same time you create a calendar entry. But I think Google keeps that capability just for themselves. Highly recommended.

Works nicely. I use this to merge 2 outlook calendars and one Google calendar. I do have an issue with one of my outlook calendars arbitrarily stopping to update, and while I don't think it's this apps problem, it would be VERY helpful if this app warned me of the situation. Because, when this occurs, you simply think you're free at certain times, when in fact those times are only showing free because a calendar has stopped updating.

The best calendar app—having relished it for nearly three and a half years! It's utmost more versatile than Google Calendar, as it includes a day slider view, history of past event titles (upon typing them), and multi-selection feature for copying and deleting. Plus, it's comparably quicker and snappier! ⚡ Pro version is totally worth it. The latest update is amazing! The UI is even better—super clean and modern. Keep it up!

I love this calendar. It has nice features, like adding an appointment in your email straight into your phone.s calendar. It.s not hard to use, to change months, you just go up and right and click settings and click " go to' and say you want january, you just select it and you can enter info on any day and you.ll be able to look in January and see appointments, birthdays, or any important events.It helps you keep your life organized so easily. I really use it most every day.

Best calendar app I've ever seen, especially for neuro-atyp people. It is way more customizable than others, so be patient with the process at first while setting everything up. Repeating daily tasks have a convenient function, where they only show in "today", and as soon as you complete them they will migrate themselves to the following day. The only thing I can think of improving is if you could increase the number of reminders for an event.

It does way more than what I need it to do, but what it does it does really well. I love the agenda feature and the ability to group the calendars and/or tasks together so that I can display them easily. I like the ability to customize the display. I wish I could uninstall the original app that I purchased, business calendar, so that I didn't have to always have both apps installed. But the license apparently is attached to the first calendar. I've used this calendaring app for years.

YES YES YES!! I have been looking for a great schedule/agenda/calendar map for centuries!! The thing I really wanted to have was a widget to put on one of my pages where I could see one week at the time, both visually (each day has its own column with different colors for different events) and verbally (each event has written inside what it is). Most other apps have simply a list of the events per day, without breaking them down visually for duration and the such. Amazing app! Love it!

Love it. FREEKING LOVE IT!!!! I just wish there were a way to create "priority" days, where you could highlight the entire block of day to make it stand out. This app has a high level of customization, however, FAR more than any other calendar app. And what's cool is that you can customize it to be very, very simple and dumbed down if you so choose so it's perfect for every user's needs. LET'S GET THAT PRIORITY DATE BLOCK GOING!! Lol =)

This app is a great app for beginners/small businesses. The free version allows you to do enough in the calendar, without obtrusive/disruptive ads. This allows someone to transition into the full version when they their business grow making the app a true asset. Of note, I am not against ads. I understand that this provides much needed operating revenue for the companies to maintain the app. But when the app has loud ads that cannot be even silenced this is a big turnoff for me.

love the app and best I've used! However I started having an issue with one of my outlook calendars. When I add an event from my computer, it displays the event one day prior on my phone. If I add the event from my phone using the app, is displays correctly on the computer. I have 5 other calendars, most from outlook, and all others work just fine. update- works fine now all of a sudden. not sure what happened. thanks
replyContent: Hi, does your stock calendar app preinstalled on the device have the same problem? If so, it would indicate a general problem not caused by BC.

content: The best, most thorough calendar app for mobile. I cannot for the life of me figure out why they leave $ on the table by not porting to iPhone. I have not found a better app for multiple calendars on either mobile platform. Data entry is smooth. Calendar & time pickers make sense. Multiple views. The # of days slider makes navigation easier than other apps I've tried. Would give this 11 if I could. Kept me on Android through multiple device upgrade cycles.

Best Calendar app! Makes my Google apps obsolete as it integrates my calendar and tasks joined seamlessly into one place. Love the ability to add links to the descriptions (and even customize the fonts!) and gives me quick access to event locations with one click. The widgets are so easy to use. Love the customizable everything. How do I get this app for IOS?? My fiance is struggling with staying organized with their janky calendar options...

SO much prettier and customizable than Google calendar! I used this wonderful app for a few months, then upgraded to the pro version -- then switched to Google calendar when I bought the Galaxy s10. Big mistake. Google calendar is ugly and brash compared to BC2. I came back! Love all the options, themes, colors, and it syncs perfectly. Get it!

About a month using this. Great views. I badly needed custom colors for appointments, I like the widgets & linking appointments to contacts without inviting them is just great, too. I have a 24 hr weekly view, stretch it to keep business hours on the screen & I just scroll a little to see early & late items. This began and ended my search for a calendar app. Certainly there are more features to be discovered, but for now, I'm just thankful to have it.

I truly, literally, honestly would not be able to keep track of my life without this app. I have seven calendars and a task list synced to my device. I'm able to color code each calendar and appointments within those calendars, plus add emojis if I need an appointment to "pop." The android widget is fantastic (mine is set as my home screen so I always see what's coming up). Cannot recommend this app more highly. I would give 50 stars if the option was available.

3 yes happy user of business calendar. best app I ever installed The must-have feature for me is the widget adjusted to full screen size and set to agenda view. I tweak the colors: gold for the date and blue for the event/appt time. I reduce the font size so I can see the coming few days all on one screen with great clarity. It's a superb way to organize and view my calendar and to do list combined. I dont use tasks, I make each to do item an untimed event on the appropriate day. Just brilliant

I have an odd schedule for work (4 week rotation) and this app let's you customize really well in reoccurring events such as this. I also have another shared email address for band gigs that I was able to sync up. I can now switch between each one and create, edit, or delete whatever events I need to. I recommend this app. The only negative that is slightly annoying is the more you use it, it has a list that pops up of past events you created when creating one and sometimes duplicates the name.

I've used paid version for years and it's been great except for the occasional glitch, usually solved by reinstalling the app. But now an event is suddenly just not showing up. I've checked everything, tried sync, install/uninstall, change color of event, toggle bottom menu tabs, checked which calendar it's on, checked if event shows on google calendar app, etc. But no, the issue is with business cal. I would have completely missed this important event if I hadn't checked my calendar on my laptop. Please fix this, a calendar that skips events is useless.
replyContent:
Hi, it might be a general sync problem and it could help to remove and re-add the account for sync in your Android OS Settings - Accounts & Sync.

Please remember that BC doesn't have its own sync abilities and uses only those provided by Android. Therefore it cannot be responsible for any sync issues you may have on the device.

content: Love it!! Was previously using the Calendar app Informant and got tired of them forcing you to repurchase their app (at high costs) just to continue on with their updates, so I tried this. It does everything and more that the other one did and so far they have only made me buy it once (as it should be!) I can't speak for the adds as I did purchase the full product since it is a great app and I wanted to support the developers. I would highly recommend it!

This is, by far, THE BEST app for keeping organized! Only thing I would suggest is an option to save info daily so that if someone's phone breaks they do not lose all their plans! Also would help to be able to actually talk to someone for technical help or about suggestions to make the app better. Otherwise, extremely impressed with this app! The amount of fore thought it took to come up with all the features that are available surpasses ANY other app I use for my business. Good job!

This is the perfect calendar for me. I searched for a long time to find a calendar that would allow me to color-code my different entries. Using the local calendar option, I can differentiate between my personal appointments and my volunteer hours, simply by making each event their own separate calendar and then assigning the calendars different colors. Thank you sooooo much!

This is the best calendar, hands down. It is the only place I can access all my calendars together AND modify them all. I use an Outlook calendar for work and multiple Google calendars for me, my aging parents, and my husband. I appreciate that I can employ various colors for different tasks, that I can contact someone directly from an appointment, and that each view conveys A LOT of information - especially for a small screen. Outstanding App!

I've used this calendar for many years and am REALLY happy with it. I have a lot of accounts with MANY calendars and I love how I can see them all in this one app (with very little effort to set up). A favorite feature is grouping calendars into favorites - with 1 tap I can show/hide the group. I love showing 2 days as my default, but easily slide to show more days. So easy to add an event to any calendar or copy to another one. I have the paid version and it was definitely worth it! LOVE it!!

This is a great option, until you find a better alternative. I've tried out several calendar apps and stuck with this one the longest. Luckily i just found aCalendar and will be moving to that. The good: this calendar is rock solid under the hood. I've had it for over a year and have zero complaints on bugs. Also very cool that they don't bombard you with ads. The bad: imo the features in the free version are lacking. And there's not much more in the pay version that makes me want to upgrade.

The simple customization of which calendars are showing with bars at the bottom of the screen is handy, and the widget with a customized compact agenda has been part of my home screens for years. The previous and current versions are 2 of the best app purchases I've made and certainly the most regularly used along with Nine. This shows my Nine (Exchange) calendars with no problems.

Been using this app for years and finally purchased the ad free version because the ads were really too intrusive and annoying - that's my only issue with the free version. The amount of customization, especially with the widgets, is amazing. Syncs seamlessly with all my calendars, and the notifications and agenda keep me on track. Haven't found a better calendar app yet.

I love Business Calendar! I love being able to color code my "appointments" (actual appointments, but also many reminders of things to do, plus birthdays, anniversaries, etc). It occasionally asks me to upgrade to the paid Pro version, but I personally do not have any need for the additional options included with the Pro version. I tried a few other calendar apps (including Google's) but I much prefer this one!! Keep up the good work 👌 5 years later & Business Calendar is still the best😎🥳🖖

Still the best calendar feature for me. I can add and track very quickly, look up or change, the color coding option is one of my favorite things and to put things like reoccurring payments on the same day for a certain period of time all at once!, really great!! I'm not sure how to improve this app, but,, if YOU come up with something new, I'm sure I will use and enjoy it!

My go-to calendar for YEARS. I love the options, how it let's me put in all the details I need, send invites, color-coded, manage multiple accounts. Only complaint is with location - I think you used to be able to put in the name of where you were going and it would find all that info and save it for you. Now you have to know the exact address. It's not a deal breaker, just a feature I miss.

As an old PalmOS user, I have looked great and wide for something that integrates calendar, address book, phone, to do list etc. This app is the closest I've found and is my go to calender app. I would take off 1/2 star off if Google play would let me sure to the way phone numbers are handled. Great calendar app, constantly improving but without ruining it or making the kind of changes that force you to relearn everything. its readily solid. Have used this for years, still love it. Favorite feature is the ability to quickly see/hide different calendars with the buttons on the month view. I love this app. I keep the month calendar widget on my home screen at all times. Really efficient app and easy to learn. Every now and then it has a problem loading, but that is rare. Best calendar I've had!!! I bought the upgraded version and I love it! I have tried out MANY different calendars through out the year and this has been by far the best I have ever used. content: The Best Calendar App that joins outlook, Google and device calendars in one view. You can toggle calendars on or off. Move calendar events. Very nice calendar to keep track of my schedule. I really like this one and use it instead of Samsung's. content: I've tried other calendars, and I just love the layout. If only the widget layout can be changed when first opened. But it shows everything I need very easily. Will not be choosing another calendar!

Finally after years if trying! I've tried a number of calendar apps and this is the best buy far. This calendar application is fantastic and it is very easy to use. The best thing about it is that you can set multiple events and reminders. I'm also glad that it doesn't have autocorrect. There are convenient weekly monthly and yearly views to choose from. Great calendar application! I highly recommended it!

İncredible utility. Perfect for people with ADHD who need a time structure for their college/job. Lets you visualize everything you have to do with blocks of time. The best feature is the customizable widget. Better than any other calendar, let's me match it to my phone perfectly. The UX is good but could use a bit of simplification. Ever in love with Business Calendar 2! It's configuration settings are of sublime finesse. For example, you can move events in 5 minute increments or even 1 minute increments. It's especially useful when moving events, as it's better than other options do on both desktop and mobile applications. Would utmost recommend to those seek a power-calendar app!

Amazingly useful. I've been using Business Calendar for years. It has some indispensable features that Google Calendar app just can't do. For example, being able to push selection of events in time by specified number of days, and have them all adjust relative to their original date. Brilliant! Or drag and drop for events. Google finally added this to their app maybe a couple of years ago, and it still doesn't work as well as the one in Business Cal. Business Cal allows you to adjust the length of events via intuitive sliding bars, where as GCal's events have to be adjusted via standard numerical inputs. Business Calendar has a ton of other useful features that are well worth the price of the app.

This is the best Calendar app ever. I don't remember where I heard of it (some youtube tech channel), but I have been using it for years, and have had no issues with it. I love the customizability, and the widgets are perfect. It allows my to change font sizes, colors, add tasks, add in multiple calendars, etc. By far the best app.

I was using the free version for a long time before upgrading and had no issues with it. Tagging locations has been a huge help since maps takes forever to open on my older phone. Being able to jump straight to directions from the widget on my home screen has been a life saver.

Hands down, my new favorite calendar app. And Ive used just about all. I'm one of those with multiple Google and Outlook calendars, and needed a way to not only see multiple calendars, but easily add and sync in one interface. The template for appointments that dont recur at a regular intervals is a huge time saver. Color coding choices, drag and drop and the options for each entry are awesome. Multiple reminder times are a huge value. There's a ton more, premium version is worth the investment!

This app is great! I've been using the paid version for several years since I've found the Google and Outlook apps to be limited in handling calendars from other systems. I especially like the way you can click on any combination of tabs at the bottom of the screen to view different calendars, with tab color coding that I can match to the font color of the appointments.

This app has a lot of great function and I do enjoy using it. Only one thing is an issue. When syncing tasks across my two android devices there seems to be a lack of information transfered. To be specific, a task will sync to my other device but the time of the reminder and other details do not sync. It will simply show up on the other device as an "all day" task. Aside from that, this is a great app.
replyContent: It is due to the old limitation of Google Task sync. They used to not support time for tasks (which has always been possible in BC). Now they do, but they didn't open the API of the function, so that other developers can adjust the sync parameters. As long as the API is closed the the tasks with time, will sync as all-day and we can't influence it.

content: Having used this app since the first version that this version replaced, there's literally nothing I can think of to add to this calendar app. It's fast, robust, configurable and dependable. This is the best calendar on the planet. That seems like an exaggeration of course but I recently switched to iPhone and they don't have this calendar available and my life is now in shambles. Business Calendar Pro has this all perfect. Perfect model of efficiency. You don't know what you've got until it's gone.

content: I'm using this to budget and I don't like Google's calendar. I got my entire months expenses mapped out and then had to delete an entry. Turns out you have to pay for that option. content: Update 1/2022. Still great! Calendaring needs have changed between needing access to Outlook and tasks. Still meets all my needs. Been using this app or the one before it for years now. It's a great app that has only improved with time. Loving the new colors. It's one of the few where I paid for the upgrade, mostly out of appreciation for a well done, well supported app. Not in any way affiliated with the app, nor did I receive anything for this review.

I've been using it for the past 4 (now 6) years. I *really* wish there was a PC version so I could manage tasks at work, without looking like I was on my phone all the time. It has features I can't find, a small memory foot print, and integrated so well. It's better than any PC app, paid or free, w/ a mobile sync app.

It's not perfect, but it's pretty awesome. Two thumbs way up!

I am extremely happy with this calendar, I have been using it for a few years now. it integrates seemlessly from google calendar, rarely glitches. There is more customization available in this app than any other calendar app that i know of (I'm picky with what i want my calendar to look like and do). i It even has more customization than i need. It works well right away with minimal setup, but during the first few weeks and months you will want to customize. It takes time to learn all features

I've been using this app for years now and I love it. The widget is perfect for checking off little tasks/due dates that you might otherwise forget about. I upgraded to the pro version, which allows you to have repeating tasks that you can check off once a week, once a month, the third Saturday of every month, etc. It can sync with your email and automatically add in flights/important dates from your calendar. I can't even tell you how much this app has improved the organization in my life

Useful. I like the layout flexibility and widgets, but mainly use it because of the ability to set up new calendar entry templates. content: I downloaded this app recently, and after checking it out some, decided to purchase the Premium version. At first it did, but then I closed the app and came back, and I was in light mode. I turned it on again--didn't work, despite saying it was on. Massive bummer.

I've been looking for something like this for a long time - I used Franklin Planners for years, but got tired of having to deal with all the waste of paper pages each year. One thing that I have noticed is that the 'dark mode' doesn't consistently persist in the settings (I use this on a Samsung Tab S7+, and have the app locked to stay in memory). I usually have to close it completely and reopen it to get dark mode to stick around. Other than that, though, this is a fantastic app.

All the others (including Microsoft and Google's products) are garbage. The only point against it is the widget doesn't show very many rows.

[1] add user defined, color adjustable tabs on the "Day's view" of the calendar just below where your upgrade banner currently shows up. [2] Add month indexing of stuff and Project tabs. &

Overall good design - pleasing to the eye and navigable. Greatly appreciate the color coding and ease of selecting a date on the calendar. Adding repeating events also a plus.
